facts.text: No published evidence was found of an off-road program compressing collision-avoidance validation from three or four years to under four months.
facts.quote: No published evidence was found of any off-road program compressing collision-avoidance validation from three or four years to under four months.

facts.text: A collision-avoidance validation window of under four months is credible only if most work happens before hardware arrives and the program uses the proposed campaign architecture.
facts.quote: The window is credible only if most of the work happens before the hardware arrives, and the program then takes the shape described below.

facts.text: The proposed campaign architecture derives a scenario catalog and parameterised families from an operating-domain taxonomy.
facts.quote: OD[Operating-domain taxonomy] --> CAT[Scenario catalog and parameterised families]

facts.text: The proposed campaign architecture uses the scenario catalog to feed a coverage stream based on combinatorial and space-filling designs.
facts.quote: CAT --> COV[Coverage stream: combinatorial and space-filling designs]

facts.text: The proposed campaign architecture uses the scenario catalog to feed a discovery stream based on falsification, adaptive search and rare-event probes.
facts.quote: CAT --> FAL[Discovery stream: falsification, adaptive search, rare-event probes]

facts.text: The proposed campaign architecture uses the scenario catalog to feed an estimation stream consisting of a frozen, pre-registered stratified random sample.
facts.quote: CAT --> EST[Estimation stream: frozen stratified random sample, pre-registered]

facts.text: The coverage, discovery and estimation streams in the proposed campaign never share data.
facts.quote: The three streams never share data

facts.text: Tuning in the proposed campaign runs only on the coverage and discovery streams plus a tuning split; the architecture includes found failures in tuning and regression.
facts.quote: Tuning and regression: tuning split plus found failures

facts.text: The collision-avoidance release claim is computed only on the frozen estimation sample plus physical anchors, with full traceability.
facts.quote: the release claim is computed only on the frozen estimation sample plus the physical anchors, with full traceability

facts.text: The proposed campaign requires automatic regression on every change.
facts.quote: automatic regression on every change.

facts.text: Physical anchors in the proposed campaign comprise calibration, correlation and confirmation, support the release claim, and validate the coverage stream.
facts.quote:
PHYS[Physical anchors: calibration, correlation, confirmation] --> REL
    PHYS -.validates.-> COV

facts.text: Before prototype hardware arrives, during October 2026 to mid-2027, the program should write a pre-registered statistical test plan specifying claims, strata, confidence levels and stopping rules.

facts.text: The collision-avoidance validation program should engage a notified body early, before prototype hardware arrives in mid-2027.

facts.text: The program should start shadow-mode field logging on the existing warning-only system immediately during the pre-prototype period of October 2026 to mid-2027.

facts.text: The program should ingest years of warning-system logs where available and classify them into encounter types, nuisance alarms, site and environment strata, and machine configurations.

facts.text: Automated campaign verdicts should go beyond collision or no collision to include first valid detection, time-to-collision at detection, intervention time, stopping margin, closest approach, false-warning duration, unnecessary braking, deceleration and jerk where relevant, sensor degradation state, and the operator-warning sequence.
